Breakdown repair and reconditioning in Ipoh

When a shaft, gear, roller or rotor fails, your line stops. Since 1989, Weng Loi Machinery has repaired, reconditioned and remade machinery parts for plants, mills, factories and contractors across Malaysia, from our workshop in Menglembu, Ipoh.

WhatsApp a photo of your part Call Lily: 017-701 4268

What we repair

  • Shafts with worn bearing journals, seal areas or threads
  • Damaged or worn keyways, cut new or resized
  • Gears and gear shafts
  • Rollers and drums, re-turned and finished
  • Electric motor rotors
  • Screw conveyors, augers and mixer paddle shafts
  • Worn bores and housing seats, re-bored to size
  • Parts with no drawing, measured from the worn original

Repair, recondition or make new

Our engineers look at the part and tell you the practical, economical option. A worn journal can often be built up by welding and machined back to size, which is usually faster than waiting months for an overseas replacement. When a part is too far gone, we make a new one, and if there is no drawing we measure and reverse-engineer it from the original.

Repair work is done in-house with 24 manual lathes, 3 CNC lathes, 11 milling machines, slotters for keyways and welding for build-up, so the job does not leave our workshop between steps.

How it works

  1. Send us the part. WhatsApp a photo, drawing or sample to Lily. A phone photo with rough dimensions is enough to start.
  2. Get a quote. We assess whether to repair, recondition or make new, and quote the practical option.
  3. Collect your part. Machined, checked and ready to install. For an urgent breakdown, tell us, and we will give you a realistic date with the quote.

Recent work

Frequently asked questions

Can you repair a worn shaft instead of making a new one?

Often, yes. Worn bearing journals and seal areas can be built up by welding and re-machined to size, and damaged keyways can be re-cut. Our engineers will tell you if repair or a new shaft is the better option for your part.

What do you need from me to give a quote?

A photo of the part and rough dimensions sent by WhatsApp to 017-701 4268 is enough to start. A drawing or the actual part helps, but is not required.

How quickly can you repair a broken part?

It depends on the part and the work involved. Tell us when it is a breakdown and your machine is stopped, and we will give you a realistic completion date with the quote.

The original part is obsolete and we have no drawing. Can you still help?

Yes. We can measure the worn or broken original and reverse-engineer a replacement.
